
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zhouxuejia/p/19686105" title="发布于 2026-03-08 14:17">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">windows10本地部署openclaw</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>本文章主要是自己手动在windows10部署openclaw遇到的问题以及部署步骤总结</p>
<h4 id="slide-6" data-spm-anchor-id="a2c6h.12873639.article-detail.i0.2d0c661376dXcE" data-ai-assistant-role="selection">1. 前置依赖安装（核心工具：Node.js）</h4>
<h5 id="slide-7">（1）Windows 10/11系统</h5>
<ol>
<li>管理员模式打开PowerShell，安装Node.js（v24.x稳定版，2026年最优适配）：
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 国内镜像加速，避免下载超时</span>
iwr -useb https://npmmirror.com/mirrors/node/v24.5.0/node-v24.5.0-x64.msi -OutFile node-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">install.msi
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">Start-Process</span> .\node-install.msi -Wait</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</li>
<li>验证安装：
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>node --version  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 需显示v24.x.x</span>
npm --version   <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 需显示v10.x.x及以上</span></pre>
</div>
<p>这里特别要注意node版本得是v24以上</p>
</li>
<li>2. OpenClaw核心安装与初始化</li>
<li>全局安装OpenClaw：</li>
<li>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>npm install -g openclaw@latest</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>第三个需要注意的问题：由于 Windows 下编译`node-llama-cpp` 可能失败，建议使用`--ignore-scripts`跳过本地 LLM 编译(如需本地 LLM 支持，需先安装 Visual Studio Build Tools)<br>powershell</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>npm install -g openclaw@latest --ignore-scripts</pre>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p>遇到问题总结（1）：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">[openclaw] Unhandled promise rejection: TypeError: Invalid URL
    at new URL (node:internal</span>/url:826:25<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    at </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">getUrl (C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\Roaming\npm\node_modules\openclaw\node_modules\undici\lib\dispatcher\proxy-agent.js:231:14)</span>
    at new ProxyAgent (C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\Roaming\npm\node_modules\openclaw\node_modules\undici\lib\dispatcher\proxy-agent.js:109:29<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    at new EnvHttpProxyAgent (C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\Roaming\npm\node_modules\openclaw\node_modules\undici\lib\dispatcher\env</span>-http-proxy-agent.js:28:31<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    at file:</span>///C:/Users/Administrator/AppData/Roaming/npm/node_modules/openclaw/node_modules/@mariozechner/pi-ai/dist/utils/http-proxy.js:11:29</pre>
</div>
<p>解决办法(1)：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> powershell 命令</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$env:HTTP_PROXY</span> = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span>
<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">$env:HTTPS_PROXY</span> = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span></pre>
</div>
<h3>(2)Gateway 无法访问（127.0.0.1 refused）</h3>
<p data-pid="4dVd2KYI">原因可能有两类：</p>
<ol>
<li data-pid="E57MPJn4">Gateway 没启动</li>
<li data-pid="mOW60l0M">端口未开放 / 被占用</li>
</ol>
<p data-pid="CGmU9dWt">正确启动方式：</p>
<div class="highlight">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>openclaw gateway</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<p data-pid="hsEogBGc">然后访问：</p>
<p data-pid="SXdxHeCx"><a class=" wrap external" href="https://link.zhihu.com/?target=http%3A//127.0.0.1%3A18789/" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank" data-za-detail-view-id="1043">http://127.0.0.1:18789</a><br>或<br><a class=" wrap external" href="https://link.zhihu.com/?target=http%3A//localhost%3A18789/" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank" data-za-detail-view-id="1043">http://localhost:18789</a><br>（端口可能随配置不同）</p>
<p data-pid="PPf7YhKf">若你启用了 dev 模式，端口变为 19001：</p>
<div class="highlight">
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>openclaw --dev gateway</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</li>
<li><ol>
<li>验证安装：
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>openclaw --version  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 需显示2026.x.x及以上版本</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</li>
<li>初始化工作空间：
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 创建工作目录（存储配置、技能与数据）</span>
mkdir ~/OpenClaw-Workspace &amp;&amp; cd ~/OpenClaw-<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Workspace
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 初始化配置，按提示选择默认值（新手无需修改）</span>
openclaw init</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h4 id="slide-11">3. 启动服务与访问控制台</h4>
<ol>
<li>启动Gateway服务：
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 前台启动（测试用，关闭终端服务停止）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">openclaw gateway start
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 后台启动（推荐，支持关闭终端后持续运行）</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Windows（PowerShell）：Start-Job -ScriptBlock {openclaw gateway start}</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">
#</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> MacOS/Linux：nohup openclaw gateway start &amp;</span></pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</li>
<li>访问控制台：<ol>
<li>浏览器输入<code>http://localhost:18788</code>，无需登录直接进入操作界面，本地部署完成。</li>
<li>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/518563/202603/518563-20260308141630477-102499868.png" alt="934697070286ced332721fe857d8534" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/518563/202603/518563-20260308141638198-825968814.png" alt="621ccf5a92179bca9a4ab2323c0c1c8" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/518563/202603/518563-20260308141645222-1449504657.png" alt="75c2b59f8e53d8b3b841853c4e50c25" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/518563/202603/518563-20260308141650853-1117852063.png" alt="e5fac8051a02fb4f65eecd26d15e8ac" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/518563/202603/518563-20260308141656957-2030408907.png" alt="56ec506b8d2c60c529e256f9edd2789" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/518563/202603/518563-20260308141702476-154832614.png" alt="41a35a33b7411805c10b046c089e61f" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</li>
</ol></li>
</ol></li>
</ol>

</div>
